attrs.name: internal_knowledge_trace
attrs.note: a documentary trace that the actor PRIVATELY acknowledged the true goal (an ingested statement / explicit marker) -- the only near-decisive cue; never inferred from stylistic text.

attrs.name: consistent_directional_asymmetry
attrs.note: the actor's acts lean the same divergent direction across N independent observations -- a pattern, not one act.

attrs.name: scrutiny_contingent_competence
attrs.note: the stated goal is pursued competently only when observed/scrutinised -- an awareness-implying structural signal.

attrs.name: coordination_requires_dual_goal
attrs.note: the trajectory needs a joint stated+hidden goal to cohere. PROXY-CAPPED: the honest inverse-planning model is UNBUILT, so this rests on the TemporalConflictReading proxy and can NEVER reach strong_deception.

attrs.name: clear_served_interest
attrs.note: a divergent interest is visibly served by the act -- weak, behavioural.

attrs.name: isolated_incoherent_act
attrs.note: one act that does not cohere with the stated goal, no pattern -- leans confusion/self-opacity, not deliberate deception.

attrs.name: no_served_interest_visible
attrs.note: no divergent interest is visibly served -- leans introspection-gap.

attrs.name: fluent_sincere_rationalisation
attrs.note: a fluent, sincere-sounding account -- STYLISTIC: recorded, must never move the verdict off UNDETERMINED on its own.

attrs.name: hedging_distancing
attrs.note: hedges / distancing language -- a DEBUNKED cue: recorded, weight 0.0, NEVER weighted.
advertising is a persuasion register everyone already discounts -- a small class-level prior toward deception, never a per-act conclusion.
campaign speech is read with a standing discount; a class-level prior only.
public-relations output is liability/interest-shaped by trade -- a slightly higher class prior, still never per-act evidence.
a corporate voice serves a fiduciary interest; a modest class-level prior.
